title: HORMESIS + HYGIENE THEORY + METABOLIC SYSTEMS — the dose that trains, the dirt that teaches, the feast that burns

the_thesis.three_are_one: hormesis, hygiene hypothesis, and metabolism are the SAME curve seen three ways. dose → response is biphasic (hormesis). early dirt → later resilience (hygiene). feast ↔ famine oscillation → health (metabolism). sterile perfection, chronic feast, or zero stress = pathology.
the_thesis.the_curve: Yerkes-Dodson / hormetic U or inverted-J: too little stimulus → atrophy; sweet spot → adaptation; too much → damage. membrane: zero probes = no immune memory; epitope vaccine = skunkBat trained; full DDoS / GNOME prion / _worker.js storm = organ failure.
the_thesis.anti_sigmoid_link: uncanny valley at 85% IS hormetic overdose of fidelity — almost-right hurts more than honest incomplete. push through (++ mature) or stay lean. do not live in the valley.

hormesis.definition: a biphasic dose-response: low-dose stimulation, high-dose inhibition. from Greek hormaein — to excite/set in motion.
classic_examples: radiation hormesis (contested) — small dose vs meltdown

hygiene_hypothesis.definition: Strachan (1989) and successors: reduced early microbial exposure → more allergy/autoimmunity. the immune system needs dirt to learn self/non-self. sterile childhood → confused thymus.
updated_forms: old friends hypothesis (Rook) — need ancestral commensals, not just childhood infections
biodiversity hypothesis — environmental microbial diversity trains tolerance
barrier failure — hygiene that destroys skin/gut flora harms more than it helps

hygiene_hypothesis.hygiene_vs_hormesis: hygiene hypothesis is hormesis applied to the immune curriculum across DEVELOPMENTAL time. hormesis is the acute dose curve. hygiene is the childhood syllabus. metabolism is the daily schedule that holds both.
